rikka-client.setting.bind.description: The key that turns this mod on or off.
rikka-client.setting.bind_mode.descripti: Toggle switches on each press; Hold keeps the mod on while the key is held.
rikka-client.setting.position.descriptio: Where this element sits on the screen.
rikka-client.setting.icon.description: Shows the icon before the text.
rikka-client.setting.background.descript: Draws a glass panel behind the text.
rikka-client.setting.custom_color.descri: Colors the text and icon with your own color instead of the theme's.
rikka-client.setting.color.description: The color of the text and icon.
rikka-client.mod.fps_display.description: Shows how many frames are drawn each second.
rikka-client.mod.ping_display.descriptio: Shows the round trip to the server, measured every second; falls back to the server's own figure when it does not answer.
rikka-client.mod.cps_display.description: Shows your mouse clicks per second.
rikka-client.mod.reach_display.descripti: Shows the distance of your last hit the server confirmed.
rikka-client.mod.reach_display.setting.d: How many digits follow the decimal point.
rikka-client.mod.combo_counter.descripti: Counts your hits in a row until you are hit or stop hitting.
rikka-client.mod.speedometer.description: Shows how fast you or your vehicle move.
rikka-client.mod.speedometer.setting.uni: The unit the speed is shown in.
rikka-client.mod.speedometer.setting.ver: Counts climbing and falling as well as horizontal movement.
rikka-client.mod.jump_reset_indicator.de: Shows how well your jump was timed against the last hit you took.
rikka-client.mod.jump_reset_indicator.se: How many ticks apart a jump and a hit may be to count.
rikka-client.mod.coords.setting.directio: Shows the compass direction you face.
rikka-client.mod.clock.setting.hour_cycl: Whether hours run to 24 or to 12 with AM and PM.
rikka-client.mod.day_counter.description: Shows how many days have passed in the world.
rikka-client.mod.weather_display.descrip: Shows the weather where you stand.
rikka-client.mod.player_counter.descript: Shows how many players are on the server or nearby.
Counts everyone in the player list, or only players loaded around you.
rikka-client.mod.server_address.descript: Shows the address of the server you play on.
rikka-client.mod.stopwatch.description: A stopwatch you start, stop and reset with keys.
rikka-client.mod.stopwatch.setting.start: Starts the stopwatch, or stops it where it is.
rikka-client.mod.stopwatch.setting.reset: Stops the stopwatch and sets it back to zero.
rikka-client.mod.memory_usage.descriptio: Shows how much of the game's memory is in use.
rikka-client.mod.memory_usage.setting.fo: Shows a percentage or the amount used of the maximum.
